summary: Frontend-only verification of Admin Dashboard header fix. Logged in as OWNER (nitinwidtech@gmail.com) and verified the header [data-testid="header-pub-name"] dynamically renders 'The George & Dragon · Norwich' (derived from pub.name + locality parsed from pub.address 'The St, Thurton, Norwich NR14 6AL'). Old hard-coded 'The Crown & Anchor · London' is gone. Header stays consistent while navigating Dashboard, Customers, Transactions, Pub Setup. Sidebar 'Active Pub' label also shows 'The George & Dragon'. Pub Setup form shows matching name/address. No regressions observed in nav or metrics load.

issues: Subtitle still hard-codes 'Real-time wallet overview for The Crown & Anchor' - not part of this fix's header scope, but same hard-coded tenant string pattern exists in the Dashboard subtitle and should be made dynamic too.

Minor cosmetic: a double space appears between pub name and the ' · ' separator ('The George & Dragon  · Norwich'). Likely from `{pub.name}{ ' · ' + deriveLocality(...) }` with trailing whitespace or an extra space in the template literal.

action_items: Fix double-space in header template between pub.name and ' · ' separator (cosmetic).
Optional: Replace hard-coded 'The Crown & Anchor' in Dashboard subtitle with pub.name for consistency with the header fix.
critical_code_review_comments: deriveLocality is inlined in Layout.jsx; consider extracting into a shared util for reuse across components (Dashboard subtitle also needs tenant-dynamic text).
Double-space rendering in header suggests the join template includes an extra space; prefer `${pub.name} · ${deriveLocality(pub.address)}` to avoid spacing bugs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header fix verified end-to-end via UI login. Dashboard page body still has a hard-coded 'The Crown & Anchor' subtitle (outside header scope). Also minor double-space between pub name and separator in header text.
